name: Enterprise Order, Subscription and Entitlement Binding
holds: Consumption Entitlement is a parked unassigned hypothesis, not a profile member with implicit identity.
Base relationship contracts and WM-ECO-024 fulfilment boundary remain unresolved.
No runtime ID, registry allocation or publication is allowed.
WM-ECO-020 is only the provisional fulfilment-evidence master until WM-ECO-024 is adjudicated.
Exactly one frozen audit was remediated without rerun; fixtures remain declarative and non-executable.

constraintRules.text: Profile mints no identity, lifecycle state, quantity, balance, version head or monetary consequence.
WM-ECO-020 provisionally owns seller-side Order, OrderLine and line quantity progress under draft waiver; exclusivity is re-asserted only on base settlement.
WM-ECO-022 provisionally owns Subscription identity, version chain, terms, suspension and renewal clocks under draft waiver; exclusivity is re-asserted only on base settlement.
WM-ECO-021 owns the pinned offer or proposal version.
WM-ECO-008 owns issued invoice, credit, debit, refund, overage and proration lines; profile stores no monetary-consequence state.
WM-ECO-009 owns payment allocation, residual and settlement exceptions; payment is never a grant basis or state trigger.
WM-FLW-015 owns actual usage events and corrections; usage never creates a grant.
UsageProjectionBinding is correspondence-only, pins WM-FLW-015 usage stream identity plus as-of time and mints no balance.
WM-ECO-020 is the provisional master of line-bound fulfilment evidence pending WM-ECO-024 adjudication; payment cannot change line residuals.
Subscription-originating lines close by creating or activating a subscription version, not by shipment.
RenewalAssertion is a read-only correspondence record of the WM-ECO-022-owned typed predecessor-to-successor link, pins both revisions, is never the sole renewal record and is never a type or model.
One effective subscription version exists per instrument and instant; effective versions are immutable.
Suspension is reversible and distinct from entitlement revocation, cancellation and termination.
Paid, delivered, entitled and used remain independent claims with independent authority.
Every binding pins source identity plus revision/version or valid/as-of time, is append-only with supersession and cannot be edited in place.
Reconstructable grants remain projections; only identityGate evidence permits a future independent entitlement candidate.
Profile cannot cascade-delete or mutate any upstream master.

bindings.OfferVersionBinding: pins WM-ECO-021 offer revision and valid time
bindings.OrderSubscriptionOrigination: pins WM-ECO-020 line and WM-ECO-022 version
bindings.EntitlementBinding: conditional correspondence to a projected or adjudicated grant; never mints identity
bindings.RenewalAssertion: read-only mirror of WM-ECO-022 successor link with both revisions pinned
bindings.FulfilmentEvidenceBinding: pins WM-ECO-020 provisional evidence identity pending WM-ECO-024 adjudication
bindings.SettlementBinding: pins WM-ECO-008/009 evidence only; never triggers grant state
bindings.UsageProjectionBinding: pins WM-FLW-015 stream identity and as-of time; mints no balance
